entities.summary: Sir Edmund Wickham Lawrence CSM JP was the third Governor-General of Saint Kitts and Nevis, serving from 2013 to 2015. He was sworn in at midnight on 1 January 2013. Lawrence was a Methodist. He taught in elementary schools in St Kitts between 1951 and 1954. Lawrence graduated from the University of London in 1966 with a degree in Economics.
